faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common questions about our products and cooperation process.

moq.q: What is your minimum order quantity?
moq.a: We offer flexible MOQ based on product type. For initial orders, we can accommodate smaller quantities to help you test the market. Contact us for specific product MOQ.

samples.q: Can I order samples before bulk purchase?
samples.a: Yes, we strongly encourage sample evaluation. Sample orders are available with shipping costs covered by the buyer. Sample costs may be credited against future bulk orders.

shipping.q: Which countries do you ship to?
shipping.a: We ship to over 50 countries worldwide including Japan, USA, Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia. We handle all export documentation and can ship via air or sea freight.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept bank transfer (T/T), PayPal for smaller orders, and can discuss letter of credit for large orders. Payment terms can be negotiated for established partners.

oem.q: Do you offer OEM/private label services?
oem.a: Yes, we offer complete OEM services including custom formulations, private label packaging, and brand-specific product development. MOQ applies for OEM orders.

quality.q: How do you ensure product quality?
quality.a: Every batch undergoes quality testing for purity, moisture content, and burning characteristics. We can provide quality certificates and test reports upon request.
